d:
Afganistan men maujud tel, gais, dhatuon, kachche mal aur dusre prakritik khanij sansadhnon ki qimat tin triliyan dolar yani 280 lakh karor rupye se zyada aanki jati hai. in sansadhnon ka ek bara hissa ab bhi zamin ke niche hai aur unhen bahar nikalne ka kam shuru nahin huaa hai. bibisi faikt chek ki is riport men afganistan ke alag-alag pranton men maujud khanij bhandaron aur khadanon ki sthiti ki janch ki gaee hai.
Riport ahmad shafi
Aavaz priyanka
